name: Folk Song
source:
This is a story of three girls and three boys that attend the high school in a rural town. This is no place for emotions, but empathy will open hearts of these three pairs to each other.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是三名少女与三名少年在乡间小镇高中就读的故事。这里仿佛容不下真挚的感情，彼此间的理解与共鸣却会令三对少男少女逐渐敞开心扉。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
